title: Hardware asset management: Centralize and automate your IT infrastructure
description: Jira Service Management now includes hardware asset management (HAM) capabilities to help you manage the entire lifecycle of your physical IT infrastructure. This update provides a centralized platform for tracking assets like laptops and servers, along with automated workflows for procurement, deployment, and retirement.
